title: The Saturday Party
text:
Maria wants to have a party on Saturday. She writes an invitation for her friends. The party starts at four o'clock in the afternoon. It is at her house on Green Street.

Her friend Tom says yes at once. He wants to bring a cake for the party. Maria is very happy about this. Everyone will bring a small gift for her.

questions.text: What does Tom want to bring to the party?
What can we infer about Tom's answer to the invitation?
options: He wants to come to the party.
He does not want to come to the party.
He is at work on Saturday.

questions.text: Why does Maria invite her friends to her house?
options: She wants to celebrate with them.
She wants to move to a new house.
She is going on a trip.

vocabulary.definition: a card or message that asks someone to come to an event
the time of day between noon and evening
something you give to someone to show you care

paragraph_translations: Maria quer fazer uma festa no sábado. Ela escreve um convite para os amigos. A festa começa às quatro horas da tarde. É na casa dela, na Rua Green.
A amiga dela, Tom, diz sim imediatamente. Ele quer levar um bolo para a festa. Maria está muito feliz com isso. Todos vão levar um pequeno presente para ela.
